parent_objective: audit outcome-supported decisive reset-validation failure before repair or rerun
supersedes: direct measured execution or materialization repair without reset-failure audit

public_gates: M2067 must audit M2066 reset counts and failure distribution
M2067 must distinguish materialization schema invalidity from scenario filter infeasibility
M2067 must choose materialization schema repair source/filter repair combined repair or branch synthesis
M2067 must not rerun reset rollout measured execution or ranking
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat generated rows as paper-valid tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits why the outcome-supported decisive materialized panel failed reset validation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: reset failure audit only; no rollout driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2066 failure classes cannot be separated
stop if next repair route is ambiguous
stop if audit would rerun reset or rollout
stop if generated rows are treated as paper-valid tasks
fallback_plan: route to materialization schema repair if warmup-gate invalidity dominates
route to source/filter repair if obstacle sampling infeasibility dominates
route to combined materialization repair if both classes require changes
route to synthesis if this branch repeats non-reset-valid task-quality failure
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2066 completes reset validation with 0/240 reset success

training_stage.stage_objective: outcome-supported decisive reset validation result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not repair and rerun before audit
do not treat reset failure as driver failure
allowed_updates: M2067 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for materialization schema repair source/filter repair combined repair or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: reset/contract evidence is separated from materialization-source validity

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2067 audits reset failures only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2067.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset failures are materialization or source-filter failures, repair the executable task panel before measured execution; do not weaken claim guards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: separates reset failure classes before choosing the next task-quality repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the outcome-supported decisive panel needs materialization schema repair, source/filter repair, or synthesis
must_synthesize_if: M2067 cannot pick one explicit repair route
M2067 routes to another design-only milestone without classifying the reset failures
M2067 finds this is a repeated non-reset-valid task-quality branch failure

hypothesis: M2066 failed closed because the M2063 executable specs contain invalid warmup-gate configs and unsampleable obstacle filters, not because metadata, actor input contract, or guardrail checks failed.
success_criteria: M2066 reset counts and fail reasons are audited
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: M2066 failure reason is not classified
new reset or rollout is performed

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit runs/m2066_paper_route_outcome_supported_decisive_reset_validation_preflight artifacts and write M2067 result audit

decision_rule: M2067 passes if it classifies the M2066 fail reason and selects a repair or synthesis route without overclaiming.
